title: CEDAR · The crown
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: The novel's last page drawn: the tree through the house has reached above the ridge, and its crown is where the glow is, and the page draws the crown lit from inside like a lamp in a room, and the family eating below, and the girl on the dock in town looking up, and the librarian, and the logger, all three right. The corner box promised CEDAR in 2017. This is what there was.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the cedar through the house grown above the ridge, its crown at the height of the glow and lit from within like a lamp.
